captions.detailed: A matte black music stand clip-on lamp featuring a flat, rectangular clamp base and an adjustable three-link segmented arm. Each arm segment is connected via a visible revolute hinge joint, allowing the arm to extend, bend, and fold. At the end of the arm, a small cylindrical lamp shade is mounted on a final pivoting joint, housing a white light emitter inside.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a clip-on music stand lamp with a rectangular clamp base, a three-link articulated arm connected by revolute joints, and a cylindrical lamp shade that tilts at the tip. Apply a dark matte finish to the entire structure.
captions.factory: Construct the clip base using a combination of box primitives for the clamp jaws. Model each of the three arm segments as box-shaped links with cylindrical hinge connectors at their ends. Create the lamp shade by subtracting an inner cylinder from an outer cylinder, and add a small white cylinder inside to represent the light source. Define revolute joints at each connection point, including the base-to-arm, link-to-link, and arm-to-shade interfaces, aligning their rotational axes.
